correctness.rationale: On 1^perp the Kn Laplacian acts as nI, and the clique Laplacians are a P_A and b P_B. With |A∩B|=1 the projection subspaces split into a-2 and b-2 independent directions plus a two-dimensional coupled plane with squared normalized inner product (a-1)(b-1)/(ab). Weighted matrix-tree determinant gives the stated PGF with correction -delta(z-1)(w-1), p=a/n, r=b/n, delta=(a-1)(b-1)/n². The bracket has a valid coupled Bernoulli law with h11=(a+b-1)/n² and h00=(n-1)(n-a-b+1)/n² >=0. Multiplying independent Bin(a-2,p) and Bin(b-2,r) laws gives the signed mass difference; telescoping yields -delta f(s-1)g(t-1) for all 1<=s<a,1<=t<b. Summing absolute binomial finite differences with unimodality gives TV exactly 2delta max f max g, including a=2 or b=2. Stirling for a/n->alpha>0,b/n->beta>0,alpha+beta<=1 gives 1/[pi n sqrt((1-alpha)(1-beta))]+o(1/n); alpha,beta are each strictly below 1 under positive sum condition. Independent exact Prüfer enumeration for n=3..6 reproduced every admissible joint pmf and signed residual; the determinant proof establishes all n.

originality.rationale: Classical matrix-tree/transfer-current, binomial one-clique marginals, edge negative association and adjacent/disjoint edge correlation are all acknowledged as prior, especially Stark 2011. The surviving claim is the exact *pair of overlapping induced-subset edge counts* jointly coupled by one Bernoulli pair, all signed upper-tail gaps, exact total variation and sharp macroscopic coefficient. Stark full text was read, with Theorems 1–3 and formulas; they concern one or two specified individual edges, not the full bivariate aggregate.
